title: Detailed glasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='lensGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#bff4ff' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#7fe0ff' stop-opacity='0.35'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e9c8ff' stop-opacity='0.45'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='lensGrad2' x1='1' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#d9c2ff' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
      <stop offset='45%' stop-color='#9be7ff' stop-opacity='0.3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c6f6ff' stop-opacity='0.5'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='frameGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9fd4'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#ff5fb0'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#c93f92'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- temples / arms -->
  <path d='M12 44 Q6 44 5 50 Q4 56 10 57' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M88 44 Q94 44 95 50 Q96 56 90 57' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- bridge -->
  <path d='M43 46 Q50 39 57 46' fill='none' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='4.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- left lens glass -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='url(#lensGrad)' stroke='none'/>
  <!-- right lens glass -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='url(#lensGrad2)' stroke='none'/>

  <!-- lens inner shading -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#8fe9ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-opacity='0.6'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='#c9b8ff' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- glints -->
  <path d='M19 46 Q23 42 28 43' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M63 46 Q67 42 72 43' fill='none' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='62' r='2' fill='#ffffff' fill-opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='62' r='2' fill='#ffffff' fill-opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- left frame rim -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='url(#frameGrad)' stroke-width='4.5'/>
  <!-- right frame rim -->
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='54' rx='19' ry='16' fill='none' stroke='url(#frameGrad)' stroke-width='4.5'/>

  <!-- rim highlights -->
  <path d='M11 50 Q12 40 24 38' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0e8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M55 50 Q56 40 68 38' fill='none' stroke='#ffd0e8' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- nose pads -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#7ff0c0'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='56' r='2.2' fill='#7ff0c0'/>
</svg>
